abstract:
Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is frequently associated with cancer cachexia, a condition characterized by progressive loss of skeletal muscle mass and strength driven by systemic inflammation. Recent evidence suggests that chemotherapy and tumor-related inflammation disrupt the gut-muscle axis, leading to increased intestinal permeability and bacterial imbalance (dysbiosis), which further worsen muscle loss.

The purpose of this pilot study is to evaluate whether an early, targeted nutritional supplement containing beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB), L-arginine, and L-glutamine can preserve or increase skeletal muscle mass in patients with locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma starting systemic chemotherapy.

Participants will be randomly assigned to one of two groups:

* Experimental group: receives standard dietary counseling plus an oral nutritional supplement (Abound, containing beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, L-arginine, and L-glutamine) twice daily for 60 days, starting 7 to 10 days before the first cycle of chemotherapy.
* Control group: receives standard dietary counseling alone.

The total study participation for each patient is 60 days, during which changes in muscle mass, muscle quality, physical function, quality of life, and blood and stool biomarkers will be evaluated.

RATIONALE AND BACKGROUND:

Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) carries a high prevalence of cancer cachexia, affecting up to 80% of patients. Chemotherapy and tumor-derived systemic inflammation compromise the intestinal mucosal barrier ("leaky gut"), promoting dysbiosis and systemic translocation of inflammatory mediators that accelerate muscle proteolysis and blunt anabolic signaling.

The NUTRI-MYO study investigates a multimodal nutritional intervention targeting key nodes of the gut-muscle axis:

* L-Glutamine serves as an essential fuel for enterocytes, supporting intestinal tight-junction integrity and gut barrier function.
* L-Arginine supports immune competence and microvascular perfusion.
* HMB (beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate) inhibits ubiquitin-proteasome proteolytic pathways while activating mTOR signaling to support muscle protein synthesis.

STUDY DESIGN AND RANDOMIZATION:

NUTRI-MYO is a prospective, randomized, open-label, monocentric pilot clinical trial enrolling 24 adult patients with locally advanced PDAC scheduled to receive first-line systemic chemotherapy.

To balance clinical, anatomical, and metabolic differences between treatment pathways, patients are stratified into two strata:

* Stratum A: Neoadjuvant setting
* Stratum B: Adjuvant setting

Within each stratum, patients are randomized 1:1 using permuted block randomization (block size = 4) into:

1. Intervention Arm (n = 12): Oral supplementation with Abound (2 sachets/day delivering 14.8 g L-Glutamine, 14.8 g L-Arginine, and 2.6 g HMB daily), initiated 7-10 days prior to cycle 1 of chemotherapy ("pre-habilitation" phase) and continued through day 60 (T60), plus standard dietary counseling.
2. Control Arm (n = 12): Standard of care dietary counseling alone.

PRIMARY AND SECONDARY ASSESSMENTS:

* Primary Outcome: Change in Skeletal Muscle Index (SMI, cm²/m²) from baseline (T0) to day 60 (T60), quantified by computed tomography (CT) densitometric analysis at the third lumbar vertebra (L3).
* Body Composition \& Muscle Quality: L3-CT assessment of muscle attenuation (myosteatosis in Hounsfield Units), visceral adipose tissue (VAT), and subcutaneous adipose tissue (SAT).
* Functional Performance: Handgrip strength and Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB).
* Nutritional \& Inflammatory Status: Serial monitoring of prognostic scores (NLR, PLR, PNI, mGPS).
* Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROMs): Quality of life via EORTC QLQ-C30, pancreatic module PAN26, cachexia module CAX24, and appetite Visual Analogue Scale (VAS).
* Translational Multi-Omics: Fecal microbiota profiling by 16S rRNA sequencing (alpha/beta diversity), systemic intestinal permeability (plasma zonulin), and an extended panel of circulating myokines and metabolic mediators (GDF-15, irisin, myostatin, follistatin, IL-15) sampled at T0 and T60.
* Oncology Follow-up: Prospective tracking of Progression-Free Survival (PFS) and Overall Survival (OS) at 6 and 12 months.

summary_ko: 본 연구는 1차 전신 항암 치료를 시작하는 국소진행성 췌장관선암(PDAC) 환자들을 대상으로 베타-하이드록시-베타-메틸부티레이트(HMB), L-아르기닌, L-글루타민이 포함된 경구용 영양 보충제가 골격근량 유지 및 증가에 미치는 영향을 평가합니다. 총 24명의 환자가 무작위로 배정되어 실험군은 표준 식이 상담과 함께 60일 동안 영양 보충제를 섭취하고, 대조군은 표준 식이 상담만 받습니다. 연구의 주요 평가변수는 제3요추(L3) CT 스캔을 통한 골격근 지수(SMI)의 변화입니다. 추가로 근육 질량, 신체 기능, 삶의 질, 혈액 및 대변 바이오마커 등을 60일 동안 평가합니다.
title: Targeted Nutritional Intervention (HMB, Arginine, Glutamine) in Patients With Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 국소진행성 췌장암 환자에서 HMB, 아르기닌, 글루타민을 이용한 표적 영양 중재 연구(NUTRI-MYO)

trial.eligibility_ko:
선정 기준:
- 18세 이상
- 조직학적 또는 세포학적으로 확진된 췌장관선암(PDAC)
- 국소진행성 질환 단계(전이 없음)
- 1차 전신 항암 화학요법(선행화학요법 또는 수술 후 보조요법) 치료 예정
- 동유럽암협력그룹(ECOG) 수행능력 상태 0~2
- 예상 여명 3개월 초과

제외 기준:
- 원격 전이 질환이 있는 경우
- 중증 신기능 장애 또는 대상부전성 간질환
- 경구 영양섭취를 방해하는 활성 장폐쇄 또는 중증 위장관 질환
- 완전 비경구 영양(TPN)만 시행하는 경우
- 연구 영양 보충제 성분에 과민증이 있는 경우
trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
* Locally advanced disease stage (non-metastatic)
* Eligibility and scheduled to start first-line systemic chemotherapy (either in neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting)
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 to 2
* Estimated life expectancy \> 3 months
* Ability to maintain adequate regular oral food intake
* Signed written informed consent to participate in the study and for biological sample storage

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of distant metastatic disease
* Severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance \< 30 mL/min) or decompensated liver disease (Child-Pugh class C, unrelated to PDAC)
* Active intestinal obstruction, sub-occlusion, or severe gastrointestinal disorder preventing oral feeding
* Exclusive Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN)
* Known hypersensitivity or allergy to any component of the study nutritional supplement (Abound: HMB, L-Arginine, L-Glutamine)
* Regular use of dietary supplements containing beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB), L-glutamine, or L-arginine within 30 days prior to study enrollment
interventions: HMB / L-Arginine / L-Glutamine oral nutritional mixture
